description: Dry run of a channel's maximum published quantity per SKU; nothing is written or sent. Positive maxQuantity sets the ceiling; null removes it. Returns product counts (total, changed, untracked, paused), a truncation flag, before/after sample quantities and a signed previewToken valid for 15 minutes. Show the person these numbers, then use set_channel_stock_limit with the SAME platform, maxQuantity and token. Physical stock and stock-write permissions stay unchanged.

maxQuantity.description: Maximum published quantity per SKU on this channel. Positive integer; null removes the ceiling. Availability after reservations remains the upper bound. Never changes physical stock.

name: preview_channel_stock_limit
title: Preview channel stock limit
